claim.statement: Applications export traces to external collectors with standard OpenTelemetry SDKs, and egress is open unless an app lists what it may reach, so an app can reach a collector outside the cluster.

sources.quote: Applications export traces to external collectors (Jaeger, Tempo, Datadog) using standard OpenTelemetry SDKs.
Egress is open unless an app lists what it may reach.

claim.measurable: An OpenTelemetry-instrumented fixture configured only through env vars in its app config sends spans for 100 uniquely tagged requests to a collector on the lab network.
